reviews.title: A solid kit that includes all mounting hardware.
reviews.comment: An excellent kit for relaxing lost or damaged AIO parts for ID Cooling product. The compatibility, fit, and function are all excellent. This kit allowed me to recover an AIO I had that was missing parts needed to mount an AM4 cpu in a budget build I was making for a client on limited budget. This kit allowed me to employ an existing 240mm AIO into the build to create a cooling option that was more aesthetically pleasing and put to use an AIO that would have otherwise been headed to the scrap heap in my shop, to be cannibalized for parts.
reviews.author: DrumzAndGunz

reviews.title: Works great! Easy to Understand!
reviews.comment: Worked perfectly for my id-cooling pinkflow aio! Recently upgraded from am4 to am5 and I didn’t want to change my cooler, so I got this kit and I was able to mount it perfectly! Very satisfied!
reviews.author: Jack Jordan

reviews.title: All necessary parts included and well packed
reviews.comment: The kit came complete with all the screws and adapters nicely organized. It made installing my liquid cooling system easy and smooth. Highly recommended for PC builders.
